budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Each trader delivers two goods of its private required type to its own dock. Exactly two physical goods of each type exist.
task.natural_termination: All three traders have delivered two goods; otherwise truncate at tick 160. A finished trader is inactive and accepts only wait.
task.interaction: One-slot inventory, narrow routes, public reservations and escrow commitments constrain others. Offers bind existing carried goods at loading bays. Reciprocal offers atomically swap a pair; if no pair clears, a compatible three-way cycle can clear atomically. No goods are copied or created.
task.observation_access: Each role sees all public yard, physical goods, reservations, posted offers and deliberately broadcast truthful signals, plus only its own private demand one-hot. Private order entities have identity-matrix visibility. A reveal action or an observed delivery may legitimately disclose demand; hidden order fields never enter another row or public scene attribute.
task.transition_order: Movement uses old occupancy, reservation and escrow state; timers decay; inventory and deliveries settle in rotating order; reservations, offers and truthful signals update; rotating bilateral matching has priority over three-way cycle clearing; expiring/settled offers clear, then joint terminal state is evaluated.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Number of atomic bilateral or three-way settlements; no reward is paid merely for trading

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
